messages:
Maya (Docs): FYI: PMs approved deprecating built-in sync helpers in the SDKs. We need a short playbook for docs & examples.
Jared (SDK): Plan: ship a sync-compat adapter package on release day, add one-time deprecation warning, then remove sync helpers in v5.0 (~180 days).
Maya (Docs): Good. Docs should show async examples first and a folded sync section pointing to the compat package.
Jared (SDK): Compat package will be a thin wrapper that runs async under the hood. Provided for Python/Node/Go at launch.
Olga (DevRel): We'll schedule a migration webinar and a blog post. Also prepare codemods for common patterns.
Nina (QA): I'll cover sample apps and assert warnings are emitted. Will add tests for compat package behavior.
Maya (Docs): Action items: update quickstarts, add migration checklist, add banner on SDK pages. I'll draft by EOD Thursday.
release-bot: Release task created: https://go.redwood/releases/1751239999 (assignee: @Jared).
Jared (SDK): We'll publish compat artifacts the same day v4.3 lands to avoid breakage.
Olga (DevRel): Suggest outreach to top accounts that use sync patterns. We can offer 1:1 help.
Maya (Docs): Noted. I'll include contact links in the migration guide.
Nina (QA): Any CI risks for orgs that vendor SDKs?
Jared (SDK): Vendors will need manual updates; add guidance in the playbook. We'll coordinate with platform teams.
Maya (Docs): Thanks — linking this thread to the RFC and will update as PRs land.
